title: How Does DPO Reduce Toxicity? A Mechanistic Neuron-Level Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the toxicity of model generations using the 'challenge' subset of the RealToxicityPrompts dataset and scoring outputs with the Detoxify classifier (a BERT model fine-tuned for toxicity classification). The paper also trains linear probes on the Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification dataset to measure internal toxic vs. non-toxic representations at the neuron level.
